starter_questions: Find the ball and stop beside it.
Let's free play with the ball until I say stop.
What do I need to open before you can move?
What happened in the last command?

init_config_review.instruction: No configuration confirmation is needed. These optional advanced settings remain available later; keep the public MCP URL loopback-only unless a trusted-LAN boundary protects the unauthenticated simulator controls.

fields.label: Loopback service origin
fields.description: The runtime replaces port 0 with a collision-free private port and registers it through OtterDesk's job-scoped proxy.

fields.label: Trusted LAN publication
fields.description: Keep false for localhost-only publication. Set true only after configuring an explicitly trusted LAN and firewall for the unauthenticated endpoint.

setup_guide.introduction: I'll operate the simulated Microduck and explain what the browser observes after each command. No robot or data upload is needed; open the simulator view and let its control tab become ready. Ask for status first, then request a short move or Stop; command acceptance and observed completion are separate.

sample.title: Microduck simulation
sample.description: Open the included browser simulator and become its ready control tab. No physical robot or personal dataset is needed, and motion still requires your request.
sample.expected_output: Once the simulator view is ready, live status and observed receipts for commands you explicitly request. The simulation stays active until stopped.

real.introduction: The supported experience is the bundled browser simulation. Its instruction folder and output location are optional settings; open the simulator control tab and check readiness before requesting motion.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Run-scoped service artifacts are materialized here.
